desc: The Frigidaire 36" Gas Cooktop offers five powerful, flexible burners that get meals on the table faster and meet all your cooking needs. Edge-to-edge continuous grates make it easy to move pots and pans without lifting, providing an effortless cooking experience.
hl: Experience faster boil times and more powerful cooking with the 18,000 BTU burner.
Simmer Burner delivers low, gentle heat
Simmer burner delivers a low heat that allows you to prepare delicate foods or sauces without burning or scorching the bottom.
Cleaning your cooktop is easier with removable, dishwasher safe burner caps.
Moving heavy pots and pans across the cooktop is easier with continuous edge-to-edge grates.
Clean-up is less of a hassle with the recessed cooktop that contains spills and common cooking messes.
We promise that your new 36" Frigidaire gas cooktop will fit your existing countertop cutout of the same width and configuration, or we will reimburse you for cabinet modification costs up to $100.
